Calculation:

Percentage of people in Teaching profession = 20%

Number of people in Teaching profession = 20% × 10000 = 2000

Percentage of males in Teaching profession = 50%

Number of males in Teaching profession = 50% of 2000

Number of males in Teaching profession = 1000

∴ The total number of males in the teaching profession is 1000.
